run_golden_clip_name: run the golden_clip_name module to generate CLIP text embeddings for golden categories
run_golden_clip_name_prompt: run the golden_clip_name module with prompt 'photo' to generate CLIP text embeddings for golden categories
run_golden_clip_name_custom_output: run the golden_clip_name module with a custom output path to save CLIP text features as numpy array
run_golden_clip_name_no_prompt: run the golden_clip_name module with prompt 'none' to generate raw category name embeddings
run_golden_clip_name_scene: run the golden_clip_name module with prompt 'scene' to generate scene-based CLIP text embeddings
